annotations: One explicit swing map per cue; source-specific rhythmic grids preserve ornaments and pickup phase.
Small ensemble and phrase-level dropout/reentry; distinct accompaniment vocabularies by setting.
No note is cut, split or rearticulated to manufacture a native safety gap.
Audited motif and harmony are transposed together; ornaments/pickup phase use each source-specific grid.
33-bar form contains32bars of thematic development plus a composed turnaround/release bar. This is musical form, not an imposed pre-bar safety gap.
Different state cues are complete compositions. Their note streams are not claimed phase-equivalent; native transitions need authored entry/bridge handling.

native_contract: One musical sequence clock. No global-safe meaning assigned to section cues. Use natural per-role key/tail windows and tested muted-role clearing/positive-gain ramps; no blanket bar chop. CC11 timeline is explicit because SCI remap does not cache expression. Cross-family swaps use authored musical transitions. One PCM speech/laughter/foley lane remains separate.
